sources.entry: Xandikos - Open source CardDAV and CalDAV server with minimal administrative overhead, backed by a Git repository. GPL-3.0 Python/deb

summary.one_liner: Xandikos is a lightweight CardDAV/CalDAV server that stores its calendar and contact data in a Git repository.
summary.what_it_does: Xandikos implements a range of WebDAV-based calendar and contact standards, including CalDAV (RFC 4791), CardDAV (RFC 6352), current principal discovery, collection synchronization (RFC 6578), and calendar availability (RFC 7953). It backs its data onto Git repositories, with one repository per calendar or addressbook. It also handles CalDAV scheduling (RFC 6638) between principals on the same server, with iTIP REQUEST/CANCEL/REPLY messages delivered to attendee inboxes. Outbound iMIP to remote attendees is off by default and can go through sendmail or SMTP. Inbound iMIP can arrive via an import subcommand or an LMTP listener. Optional WebDAV-Push support is available via a flag. The README lists many tested clients, including DAVx5, Thunderbird, evolution, vdirsyncer and iOS.
use_cases: sync calendars and contacts to phone or desktop
share calendars with family or team
notable: Stores all calendar and contact data as Git repositories
Implements CalDAV scheduling with iMIP inbound and outbound delivery
Includes an LMTP endpoint for receiving iMIP from a mail server
Ships a Containerfile with environment-variable configuration
Supports WebDAV-Push via Web Push with VAPID
caveats: Core WebDAV LOCK operations are not implemented; RFC 7529 quota is not implemented
